name: MsaSparseAttnFwd

k.description: Paged K cache [num_pages, Hkv, blk_kv, 128] bf16

v.description: Paged V cache [num_pages, Hkv, blk_kv, 128] bf16

k2q_row_ptr.description: k2q CSR 行指针 [Hkv, total_rows+1] int32 (块号优先、批次次之)

k2q_q_indices.description: k2q CSR q 序号 [Hkv, total_q*topK] int32, 尾部 -1 填充

seqused_k.description: 每请求有效 kv 长度 [B] int32

topK.description: 每查询选中的 KV 块数 (4/8/16/32)

blk_kv.description: 稀疏块大小 (= 页大小, MiniMax-M3 为 128)

reference:
import zlib

import torch


def run(q, k, v, k2q_row_ptr, k2q_q_indices,
        cu_seqlens_q, cu_seqlens_k, seqused_k, page_table,
        topK, max_seqlen_q, max_seqlen_k, blk_kv, causal,
        softmax_scale):
    """SM100 MSA block-sparse attention forward (prefill) golden.

    对标 fmha_sm100 的 sparse_atten_func；vLLM 调用点:
    MiniMaxM3SparseMSAImpl.forward 的 prefill 路径，即 MiniMax-M3
    lightning indexer 选出 top-k KV 块后的主稀疏注意力。

    布局约定:
        q              [total_q, Hq, 128]            bf16 (varlen 拼接)
        k, v           [num_pages, Hkv, blk_kv, 128] bf16 paged KV 缓存
        k2q_row_ptr    [Hkv, total_rows + 1]         int32 CSR 行指针;
                       全局行 r <-> (batch b, batch 内块号 j), 按 "块号优先、
                       批次次之" 列优先线性化
        k2q_q_indices  [Hkv, total_q * topK]         int32, 每行内存 batch 局部
                       q 序号 (按 (行, q) 稳定排序), 尾部 -1 填充
        cu_seqlens_q/k [B+1] int32 前缀和; seqused_k [B] int32
        page_table     [B, max_pages] int32
        输出           [total_q, Hq, 128] bf16
    """
    _Q_CHUNK = 256
    device = q.device
    total_q, Hq, D = q.shape
    Hkv = k.shape[1]
    G = Hq // Hkv
    B = cu_seqlens_q.numel() - 1
    cu_q = cu_seqlens_q.long()
    cu_k = cu_seqlens_k.long()
    topK, blk_kv = int(topK), int(blk_kv)

    # ---- 1. CSR 全局行 -> (batch, 块号) 逆映射 ("块号优先、批次次之") ----
    kv_lens = cu_k[1:] - cu_k[:-1]
    rows_per_batch = (kv_lens + blk_kv - 1) // blk_kv
    total_rows = k2q_row_ptr.shape[1] - 1
    max_rows = int(rows_per_batch.max().item()) if B > 0 else 0
    jj, bb = torch.meshgrid(torch.arange(max_rows, device=device),
                            torch.arange(B, device=device), indexing="ij")
    row_sel = jj < rows_per_batch[bb]
    row_batch = bb[row_sel]
    row_block = jj[row_sel]
    assert row_batch.numel() == total_rows, "k2q_row_ptr 行数与 cu_seqlens_k 不一致"

    # ---- 2. k2q CSR -> q2k [Hkv, total_q, topK] (集合语义还原) ----
    q2k = torch.full((Hkv, total_q, topK), -1, dtype=torch.long, device=device)
    for h in range(Hkv):
        ptr = k2q_row_ptr[h].long()
        counts = ptr[1:] - ptr[:-1]
        nnz = int(counts.sum().item())
        if nnz == 0:
            continue
        rows = torch.repeat_interleave(torch.arange(total_rows, device=device), counts)
        q_local = k2q_q_indices[h, :nnz].long()
        qg = cu_q[row_batch[rows]] + q_local
        jb = row_block[rows]
        order = torch.argsort(qg * (max_rows + 1) + jb, stable=True)
        qg_s, jb_s = qg[order], jb[order]
        pos = torch.arange(nnz, device=device)
        is_start = torch.ones(nnz, dtype=torch.bool, device=device)
        is_start[1:] = qg_s[1:] != qg_s[:-1]
        grp = torch.cumsum(is_start.long(), 0) - 1
        rank = pos - pos[is_start][grp]
        keep = rank < topK
        q2k[h, qg_s[keep], rank[keep]] = jb_s[keep]

    # ---- 3. 块稀疏注意力 (fp32 内部计算; 按 batch / kv-head 分组, query 维分块) ----
    out = torch.zeros(total_q, Hq, D, dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
    arange_blk = torch.arange(blk_kv, device=device)
    for b in range(B):
        q0, q1 = int(cu_q[b]), int(cu_q[b + 1])
        qlen = q1 - q0
        if qlen == 0:
            continue
        L = int(seqused_k[b])
        if L == 0:
            continue
        nblocks = (L + blk_kv - 1) // blk_kv
        pages = page_table[b, :nblocks].long()
        k_b = k[pages].reshape(nblocks * blk_kv, Hkv, D)[:L].float()
        v_b = v[pages].reshape(nblocks * blk_kv, Hkv, D)[:L].float()
        q_b = q[q0:q1].float()
        q_pos = torch.arange(qlen, device=device) + (L - qlen)  # bottom-right 因果对齐

        for kv_h in range(Hkv):
            q_h0 = kv_h * G
            q_h1 = q_h0 + G
            sel_h = q2k[kv_h, q0:q1]              # [qlen, topK] batch 内块号
            tok_idx = sel_h[..., None] * blk_kv + arange_blk
            tok_valid = ((sel_h[..., None] >= 0) & (sel_h[..., None] < nblocks)
                         & (tok_idx < L))
            if causal:
                tok_valid &= tok_idx <= q_pos[:, None, None]
            S = topK * blk_kv
            tok_idx = tok_idx.reshape(qlen, S)
            tok_valid = tok_valid.reshape(qlen, S)
            row_has = tok_valid.any(dim=-1)       # 无可见 token 的行输出 0

            k_h = k_b[:, kv_h]
            v_h = v_b[:, kv_h]
            q_blk = q_b[:, q_h0:q_h1] * softmax_scale

            for s in range(0, qlen, _Q_CHUNK):
                e = min(qlen, s + _Q_CHUNK)
                idx = tok_idx[s:e].clamp(0, L - 1)
                k_g = k_h[idx]
                v_g = v_h[idx]
                scores = torch.einsum("qgd,qsd->qgs", q_blk[s:e], k_g)
                scores = scores.masked_fill(~tok_valid[s:e, None, :], float("-inf"))
                rh = row_has[s:e]
                scores = torch.where(rh[:, None, None], scores, torch.zeros_like(scores))
                attn = torch.softmax(scores, dim=-1)
                attn = torch.where(rh[:, None, None], attn, torch.zeros_like(attn))
                out[q0 + s: q0 + e, q_h0:q_h1] = torch.einsum("qgs,qsd->qgd", attn, v_g)
    return out.to(torch.bfloat16)


_DTYPE_CODE = {0: torch.float16, 1: torch.bfloat16, 2: torch.float32}


def make_inputs(axes, device):
    """Custom input generator (custom_inputs_entrypoint).

    Deterministic per case: RNG is reseeded from the axes dict so repeated
    calls (once per custom input) produce identical tensors. Tensors are
    generated on CPU; the evaluator moves them to the target device.
    Scalars (topK/blk_kv/causal/max_seqlen_*/softmax_scale) are returned as
    plain Python values (workloads may not mix custom and non-custom inputs).

    axes:
        B               batch 数
        CUQ_0..CUQ_B    cu_seqlens_q; CUK_0..CUK_B  cu_seqlens_k
        SU_0..SU_{B-1}  seqused_k
        TQ              total_q (= CUQ_B); HQ q-head 数; D head dim
        NP              num_pages; HKV kv-head 数; MP max_pages
        BLKV            稀疏块/页大小; TOPK 每查询选块数
        MAXQ, MAXK      max_seqlen_q / max_seqlen_k
        CAUSAL          0/1
        DT              q/k/v dtype code (0=fp16, 1=bf16, 2=fp32)
        SCALE_U         softmax_scale * 1e6 as int
    """
    torch.manual_seed(zlib.crc32(repr(sorted(axes.items())).encode()) & 0x7FFFFFFF)
    B = axes["B"]
    cu_q = torch.tensor([axes[f"CUQ_{i}"] for i in range(B + 1)], dtype=torch.int32)
    cu_k = torch.tensor([axes[f"CUK_{i}"] for i in range(B + 1)], dtype=torch.int32)
    seqused = torch.tensor([axes[f"SU_{i}"] for i in range(B)], dtype=torch.int32)
    total_q, Hq, D = axes["TQ"], axes["HQ"], axes["D"]
    num_pages, Hkv, blk_kv = axes["NP"], axes["HKV"], axes["BLKV"]
    topK, max_pages = axes["TOPK"], axes["MP"]
    dt = _DTYPE_CODE[axes["DT"]]

    def random_tensor(shape, dtype):
        # 标准输入分布: 50% 均匀 [-5, 5] + 50% 正态 (mu ∈ [-5, 5], sigma ∈ [0.1, 2])
        if torch.rand(1).item() < 0.5:
            return torch.empty(shape, dtype=dtype).uniform_(-5.0, 5.0)
        mu = float(torch.empty(1).uniform_(-5.0, 5.0).item())
        sigma = float(torch.empty(1).uniform_(0.1, 2.0).item())
        return torch.normal(mu, sigma, shape, dtype=dtype)

    q = random_tensor([total_q, Hq, D], dt)
    k = random_tensor([num_pages, Hkv, blk_kv, D], dt)
    v = random_tensor([num_pages, Hkv, blk_kv, D], dt)

    kv_lens = [int(seqused[b]) for b in range(B)]
    rows_pb = [(L + blk_kv - 1) // blk_kv for L in kv_lens]
    total_rows = sum(rows_pb)

    # ---- 物理合法的 q2k 选择 (indexer 只会从因果可见块中选) ----
    q2k = torch.full((Hkv, total_q, topK), -1, dtype=torch.int32)
    for b in range(B):
        q0, q1 = int(cu_q[b]), int(cu_q[b + 1])
        qlen = q1 - q0
        L = kv_lens[b]
        nb = rows_pb[b]
        for h in range(Hkv):
            for qi in range(qlen):
                visible = min((qi + L - qlen) // blk_kv + 1, nb)
                if visible <= 0:
                    continue
                if visible <= topK:
                    chosen = torch.arange(visible, dtype=torch.int32)
                else:
                    chosen = torch.randperm(visible)[:topK].sort().values.int()
                q2k[h, q0 + qi, :chosen.numel()] = chosen

    # ---- q2k -> k2q CSR ("块号优先、批次次之" 行序) ----
    row_of = {}
    r = 0
    for j in range(max(rows_pb)):
        for b in range(B):
            if j < rows_pb[b]:
                row_of[(b, j)] = r
                r += 1
    row_ptr = torch.zeros(Hkv, total_rows + 1, dtype=torch.int32)
    qidx = torch.full((Hkv, total_q * topK), -1, dtype=torch.int32)
    for h in range(Hkv):
        rows_flat, q_flat = [], []
        for b in range(B):
            q0, q1 = int(cu_q[b]), int(cu_q[b + 1])
            sel = q2k[h, q0:q1].long()
            qlen = q1 - q0
            rm = torch.tensor([row_of[(b, j)] for j in range(rows_pb[b])])
            valid = sel >= 0
            rows_flat.append(rm[sel.clamp(min=0)][valid])
            q_flat.append(torch.arange(qlen).unsqueeze(1)
                          .expand(qlen, topK)[valid])
        rows_cat = torch.cat(rows_flat)
        q_cat = torch.cat(q_flat)
        counts = torch.zeros(total_rows, dtype=torch.long)
        counts.scatter_add_(0, rows_cat, torch.ones_like(rows_cat))
        row_ptr[h, 1:] = counts.cumsum(0).int()
        order = torch.argsort(rows_cat * (total_q + 1) + q_cat, stable=True)
        qidx[h, :rows_cat.numel()] = q_cat[order].int()

    assert total_rows <= num_pages
    perm = torch.randperm(num_pages)
    page_table = torch.zeros(B, max_pages, dtype=torch.int32)
    cursor = 0
    for b in range(B):
        nb = rows_pb[b]
        page_table[b, :nb] = perm[cursor:cursor + nb].int()
        cursor += nb

    return {
        "q": q, "k": k, "v": v,
        "k2q_row_ptr": row_ptr, "k2q_q_indices": qidx,
        "cu_seqlens_q": cu_q, "cu_seqlens_k": cu_k, "seqused_k": seqused,
        "page_table": page_table,
        "topK": topK, "max_seqlen_q": axes["MAXQ"], "max_seqlen_k": axes["MAXK"],
        "blk_kv": blk_kv, "causal": axes["CAUSAL"],
        "softmax_scale": axes["SCALE_U"] / 1e6,
    }
description: SM100 MSA block-sparse attention forward (prefill), golden for fmha_sm100 sparse_atten_func (vLLM MiniMaxM3SparseMSAImpl prefill path). Per (batch, query, q-head) with GQA group g = h // (Hq/Hkv): visible blocks are the q2k top-k selection (recovered from the k2q CSR); token-level masking covers seqused_k truncation and bottom-right causal alignment; scores = softmax_scale * q . k; rows with no visible token output 0. fp32 internal compute, bf16 output. Inputs are generated by make_inputs (custom_inputs_entrypoint): q/k/v standard mixed; q2k block selection is physically constrained to causally visible blocks; k2q CSR is built block-major; page_table is a random permutation.
